_doc: Task 6G section 11. Stage G0: overfit 20 deterministic records (10 same-image/different-target pairs) with the dense heatmap objective and measure the G0 gate on the real query-to-heatmap path. A pass is implementation proof only.

oracle_selection.rule: smallest grid whose snapped-point oracle keeps paired >= 18/20 and strict mIoU >= 0.4576 (continuous point oracle 0.4876 minus 0.03)

head.structure: query: LayerNorm(2048) -> Linear(2048,128); visual: Conv1x1(C,128); heatmap = dot(q, K)/sqrt(128) + scalar bias

no_gt_leakage_audit.query_path_inputs: image + instruction + constant [BOX] + frozen SAM2 features only

selection.reason: G0 is a 20-record implementation proof; its weights are fitted to those 20 records, so G1 starts from the same clean base with fresh LoRA, token rows and dense head.
